page.overview:
Who is Shannon Spokes?

"Spokes weaves her way into the middle of the action for in-the-moment interviews, and she's not afraid to ask racers the tough questions."

"On-the-track reporting is what Shannon Spokes does best. Always in the middle of the action, she is known for weaving her way into the trickiest of interviews and shines as an RSN pit road reporter. She asks the tough questions and does in-the-moment interviews in the pits and on the track. If there is a big success - or a big mess - just look for Shannon. She's the one in the stylish headset."

"Followers from all over the world tune in to watch TV coverage of the Piston Cup. Experience commentator Shannon Spokes adds her expert views to the action as it happens!"

Spokes interviews Lightning McQueen wins the first race at the Motor Speedway of the South, she interviews him why he gets focused to race against Bobby Swift and Cal Weathers and watches that Cal and his team with Bobby make a joke and called him cupcake. Later she interviewed Cal for win against McQueen at the Rocker Arms International, but Lightning with Bobby and Guido inflate Cal's tires with McQueen's balloons as revenge. Near the end of the season, during Los Angeles 500 race at Los Angeles International Speedway, she says there are 40 laps left and Jackson Storm goes to the pit row while McQueen goes behind him and sees a difference between victory and defeat.
